Be ready to get a better view of the night sky in your backyard with 25% off the Celestron Cometron 7x50 binoculars in this Black Friday deal
stories.t: For Black Friday week, Amazon has slashed the price of these budget family binoculars down to $36, their lowest price since April. They are great for viewing the moon and constellations.

stories.h: Kodak’s next collectible is a tiny digital photo frame that doubles as a tracker
stories.t: After expanding its Charmera collection with a Millennium Edition featuring Y2K-inspired designs earlier this year, Reto's follow-up to its tiny Kodak camera is an equally small digital photo frame you can use to display your shots.

stories.h: How did the COP31 climate agreement fall apart – and what happens now?
stories.t: Division over fossil fuels at this year’s UN climate summit scotched any hope of a deal – despite Australian efforts.

stories.h: Common medications may secretly rewire your gut, with effects lasting for years
stories.t: Medications taken years or even long ago may leave lasting changes in your gut microbiome, according to a study of more than 2,500 people.

stories.h: Interstellar solar sails hit a bizarre problem at 75% of light speed
stories.t: Scientists have discovered a surprising obstacle to interstellar travel: at extreme speeds, the light propelling futuristic solar sails could actually begin slowing them down.
